title: Content modelling and data: agent skills for TYPO3
header: Content modelling and data in 95 seconds
description: Define content types in one YAML file each, import and translate records the way TYPO3 expects, and tag news in bulk. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 95 seconds: Content modelling and data, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-content-blocks, typo3-datahandler, typo3-translations, typo3-news-tags). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: New content types, imported records and translations, without breaking a single relation.
Content modelling and data: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Defines content elements, records and page types in one config.yaml each.
The teaser shows up in the wizard. An editor fills it in and saves.
Creates, changes, translates and deletes records from PHP through DataHandler.
Raw INSERTs look fine until the reference index is stale or imported records belong to nobody.
Fixes labels and XLIFF files, including plural forms with ICU MessageFormat.
A raw label key on screen or duplicate ids after a merge are small bugs that editors see first.
Generates thematic tags for EXT:news and assigns them to existing articles by keyword.
It is made for archives too large to tag by hand, on TYPO3 v14.3 with georgringer/news 14.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
